model.name: Task 27.3: Per-task MD view generation (every 📄 link resolves, no 404)
model.description: generate-sprint-md emits ONE task-<slug>.md per Task unit (title + ACs + statusChecklist + chain links) and taskMdHref resolves to it -> HTTP 200, never 404. Root cause is SLUG DRIFT: slugify(sprintName) != the actual sprint dir (same flaw as the dup sprint-26 dir, fixed via model.slug pinning). Fix = resolve the MD path from the pinned model.slug / actual dir (not a re-slugified name) + tasks stop pointing model.sourceFile at planning.md (which collapses all tasks to one view).
model.intention: Tron-visible 404 fix: every task-detail 📄 Scenario/MD link must open its OWN task MD file, not 404. Ship FAST (ahead of the R27.2 migration).
